rows.name: FY 2000 omnibus budget as voted at the May 8, 1999 Annual Town Meeting (Article 41)

rows.what_it_is: As 2001's p81: report-appropriations under table_family omnibus-budget, a BUDGET; never summed with accountant-schedule ACTUALS. No column header is printed (account | line | amount). Left-hand column, lines 122 to 300. The three sources the vote names sum to the printed TOTAL BUDGET VOTED: 149,812 + 100,000 + 14,477,040 = 14,726,852. The account number lands in v1 on rows where it is a plain integer and in the label where it is not (`122.1`, `242/243`, `429-210`): column_meaning says `not established` (NEEDS.md asks for these as identifiers). The validator's column check (col 3 to TOTAL BUDGET VOTED) closes across both tables
